div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Refractory pulmonary oedema
or cardiogenic shock

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
HF symptoms, or echo signs of
poor haemodynamic tolerance - I B

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: No

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Abscess, false aneurysm, fistula,
enlarging vegetation, prosthetic
dehiscence, NEW AV BLOCK - I B

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Fungal or multiresistant
organism - I C

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Blood cultures STILL POSITIVE
>1 WEEK on appropriate abx - IIa B

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: No

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Vegetation >=10 mm AND >=1 embolic
event despite appropriate abx - I B

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Vegetation >=10 mm AND another
indication for surgery - I C

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Vegetation >=10 mm, NO severe valve
dysfunction, NO embolism,
and LOW surgical risk - IIb B

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: No

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
TIA, or ischaemic stroke with
NO coma and haemorrhage
EXCLUDED on CT/MRI

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Intracranial haemorrhage,
patient STABLE

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
ICH but UNSTABLE from HF,
uncontrolled infection, or
persistent high embolic risk

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(224, 242, 254) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
CONFIRMED IE
Ask the 3 surgical questions
EVERY day - involve the
Endocarditis Team early

div.style: color: rgb(237, 233, 254) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
1. HEART FAILURE?
Severe acute regurgitation,
obstruction, or fistula

div.style: color: rgb(255, 228, 230) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
EMERGENCY
within 24 h - Class I B
Do not wait to finish
an antibiotic course

div.style: color: rgb(254, 243, 199) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
URGENT
within 3-5 days
Antibiotics cannot sterilize
an abscess or a prosthesis

div.style: color: rgb(237, 233, 254) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(237, 233, 254) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3. HIGH EMBOLIC RISK?
Vegetation size + prior embolus

div.style: color: rgb(207, 250, 254) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
MAY BE CONSIDERED
Weigh embolic risk against
operative risk - Heart Team call

div.style: color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
MEDICAL THERAPY
Complete the full IV course.
Reassess DAILY - the answer
can change any day

div.style: color: rgb(237, 233, 254) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(255, 228, 230) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
DO NOT DELAY
Operate if otherwise
indicated - Class I B

div.style: color: rgb(207, 250, 254) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
DELAY >1 MONTH
if possible - Class IIa C
Reassess clinically + by imaging

div.style: color: rgb(207, 250, 254) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Still CONSIDER urgent or
emergency surgery - IIa C
Weigh the chance of a meaningful
neurological outcome

div.style: color: rgb(226, 232, 240) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
RIGHT-SIDED IE - a DIFFERENT number
Residual tricuspid vegetation >20 mm
after RECURRENT septic pulmonary
emboli - Class I C.
Do NOT apply the 10 mm rule here.
